newsitem.title: UK: Gehe makes bid for Lloyds Chemists.
newsitem.headline: Gehe makes bid for Lloyds Chemists.

text.p: Gehe AG said on Monday that is offering 500p in cash for each share in Lloyds Chemists Plc and 322.6p in cash for each Lloyds preference share, valuing the company at 650.6 million stg.

Gehe, a German pharmaceutical wholesaler, submitted a 650 million stg offer for Lloyds earlier this year and has been locked in a takeover for Lloyds with UK group Unichem Plc, which is offering 657.6 million stg in cash and shares.
Dieter Kammerer, chairman of GEHE, said, "This is a highly attractive offer because unlike Unichem's bid it is all cash and is therefore risk-free for Lloyds' shareholders."
"I believe that our renewed offer of 500p per share in cash is notably generous given the deterioration in Lloyds Chemists' performance in the last financial year."
